question: Two cars start from the same point and travel in opposite directions. If one car travels at 40 km/h and the other at 50 km/h, after 5 hours, how far apart are they?
solution:

Speed of the first car = 40 km/h.

Speed of the second car = 50 km/h.

Time = 5 hours.

Distance = Speed × Time
